title: C DTN uses uptime as Unix time (violates clockless-node MUST); DTN S-flag HBH option absent
description: Spec 05-routing.md §9.8 (R-05-080): 'Nodes without valid wall-clock time MUST NOT drop messages based on expiry timestamp alone; they SHOULD forward or store messages and let downstream nodes with valid time enforce expiry.' Violation: C lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:53-56 dtn_get_unix_time() returns k_uptime_get()/1000 (uptime AS Unix time), used for expiry at :62,:89,:283 and TTL at :159-160 — a clockless node will drop/expire against uptime. Directly contradicts docs/firmware-time-provider.md:110-111 ('Never synthesize Unix time from uptime'); the real wall-clock provider exists (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c:770 lichen_wall_clock_valid) but is not wired into DTN. Also: the DTN wire format (S flag in IPv6 hop-by-hop options; App Data Type 0x03 absolute expiry) is absent in all three implementations — C packet->dtn_expiry_unix is caller-populated and only test code populates it (lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c:395); docs/spec-chapter-breakdowns.md:415-417 lists HBH option work as pending. Fix: wire lichen_wall_clock_valid into DTN expiry decisions (fail-open to store/forward when invalid), implement S-flag/HBH expiry option, add vectors.
close_reason: COMPLETE - all three implementations carry the DTN S-flag/HBH expiry option per spec 05 9.8 + R-05-080, verified against the SHARED corpus test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (spec-derived independent oracle): (1) C: coap_dtn.c dtn_wall_clock (R-05-080 fail-open) + router.c HBH DTN option (type 0x03, FLAG_S 0x80) - routing_dispatch host suite 100% incl. fail-open and positive-control deadline cases (verified two rounds ago); (2) Rust: dtn_option.rs port + dtn_option_vectors.rs - 8/8 (bead b7z9.8.3, commit 1a166bf3ff); (3) Python: dtn_option.py implementation + test_dtn_option.py 13/13 (this round - the pre-existing import break was fixed via bead 104v, commit dfb326b7f8). Children b7z9.8.3 and 104v closed; the parity matrix is complete across all three implementations. No open children remain.
